transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We have a situation with the polymer resin shipment being delayed, but I understand we have 210 kilograms of the normal resin and 90 kilograms of an alternate resin lot available in the warehouse. The injection-molding line is idle and could produce 600 housings tomorrow if we authorize using the alternate material. Since this would be a non-routine material run, I need to follow our pre-run authorization routine. I'd like to convene an authorization meeting where our materials engineer and compliance specialist each present their formal review findings on this alternate resin. Once I've heard both reviews, I can record the applicable controls and make my decision on whether to release this run. Can we get that meeting scheduled right away?
